name: GenLayer Studio Network

artifact.note: Comment- and docstring-stripped build, proven AST-equivalent to the documented source by script/build_genlayer.py. Deployed because the 34KB documented source estimates at 27.3M gas.

notes: Deployed to studionet, NOT Bradbury. Bradbury refuses the deploy: the stripped artifact estimates at 21.65M gas and the node's per-transaction ceiling sits between 10M (accepted, reverts out-of-gas) and 19M (refused as too high). The court's immutable verdict_emitter points at 0x6414F02bB750a11442517c09322b43Bc8fb92Cb6, which is unoccupied: Studio implements no ghost contracts and its EVM RPC rejects forge's transaction shape, so VerdictEmitter cannot be co-located with its court. The EVM emit path is therefore inert here; the optimistic path does not use it, since the keeper reads the verdict() view over RPC.
